_comment: Where the fixed units stand on the bench (metres, x = east, y = north, from the base), and how the bench maps onto Jezero. Bench metres are multiplied by 'scale' so a room-sized test shows up as a walk-sized route. The scale is a demo device: positions on the Mars map are SIMULATED placements of real bench measurements.

A1.name: Buddy beacon A1 (carried by the second walker)

_calibration: 2026-11-15: indoor readings at 1 m ranged 1.5-7 m, so no true calibration. Rough fixed correction 2.5 m per fixed unit (A1 buddy: 1.0 m from its 1.4-2.5 m readings at ~1 m). Buddy limit 15 m, above the noise.
